cards.name: control
cards.headline: YouTube for kids, <mark>without the algorithm.</mark>

ad.text:
You set the age, the tone, the time of day and how long it runs. We build the playlist to match. Nothing autoplays that you didn't choose, nothing is recommended, and there is no next video waiting.

The videos come from YouTube, so what your child already loves is still there. The feed around it is not.

ad.description: Free on one playlist. No card.

cards.name: it-ends
cards.headline: When the playlist ends, <mark>it ends.</mark>

ad.text:
Twenty minutes means twenty minutes. When the playlist ends, nothing follows it: no up next, no rabbit hole, and no argument about just one more.

You set the length before they press play.

cards.name: bedtime
cards.headline: Twenty calm minutes before bed. <mark>Then it stops.</mark>

ad.text:
After school is not the same as bedtime, and the playlist shouldn't be either. Choose calm, choose bedtime, choose twenty minutes, and we build a playlist to match.

Then it stops, and they go to bed.

Nothing is recommended. Nothing turns up that you didn't choose.

ad.text:

Nothing is recommended, and when it ends, it ends.
